projects.name: Kiwi Budget Tours — AI Travel Booking Platform
projects.tagline: End-to-end travel platform with multi-LLM conversational agents.
projects.problem: Independent travelers in New Zealand faced fragmented operator pricing, disjointed schedules, and manual booking friction.
projects.solution: Built a centralized self-service booking platform with WhatsApp & web AI chat agents (Claude, Gemini, Grok, OpenAI) that deliver real-time route options and instant booking.
projects.impact: Eliminated manual booking overhead and reduced route discovery time from hours to seconds.

projects.name: AI CV & Cover Letter Generator (Telegram Bot)
projects.tagline: Automated ATS resume alignment and tailored cover letter builder.
projects.problem: Job seekers waste hours tailoring CVs to complex job specs with poor keyword alignment and low interview conversion.
projects.solution: Built a Telegram bot that parses job URLs or text, runs Claude API schema-validated skill gap analysis, and generates tailored ATS-compliant CV and cover letter drafts.
projects.impact: Delivers bespoke application packs in under 45 seconds.

projects.name: Creative Nails & Heena by Nidhi — Digital Service & Booking Platform
projects.tagline: Mobile-first client appointment and showcase platform.
projects.problem: Local service business relied on manual phone and direct messaging coordination with fragmented booking records.
projects.solution: Designed and deployed a mobile-responsive beauty services platform using Google AI Studio and Google Antigravity, streamlining client inquiries, service catalogs, and booking flows.
projects.impact: Streamlined client appointment workflows and expanded local digital visibility in Auckland.

projects.name: The Pragati Journal — Digital Editorial & Research Platform
projects.tagline: Long-form journalism and investigative research archive.
projects.problem: Independent research articles and investigative journalism required a dedicated, high-readability digital publication home.
projects.solution: Developed a full digital editorial publication platform with structured category filtering, article archives, and responsive long-form reading typography.
projects.impact: Delivered high-performance reading experience with zero server latency.

projects.name: AI Business Intelligence Copilot
projects.tagline: Natural language analytics engine generating instant SQL, DAX, and Plotly charts.
projects.problem: Non-technical stakeholders struggle to extract fast, structured answers from raw business tabular datasets.
projects.solution: Engineered an AI copilot that ingests raw tabular datasets, runs automated data profiling and anomaly detection, and produces Plotly charts and DAX/SQL queries.
projects.impact: Reduces dataset exploratory analysis time by over 70%.

projects.name: NZ EV Demand & Econometric Fuel Elasticity Thesis
projects.tagline: 15-year macroeconomic panel analysis & 3,512 km Nissan Leaf field trial.
projects.problem: Determining whether market fuel prices alone trigger EV adoption or if government policy stability and total cost of ownership (TCO) govern adoption velocity.
projects.solution: Conducted 15-year panel data analysis across 4 nations, 103-consumer primary survey, and 3,512 km real-world trial. Designed a 7-step revenue-neutral policy roadmap.
projects.impact: Quantified NZ EV fuel price elasticity and outlined a roadmap targeting 48% transport CO2 reduction by 2030.

projects.name: Gilmours Wholesale Logistics & Workflow Redesign
projects.tagline: Root-cause delay analysis and digital dispatch manifest redesign.
projects.problem: Loading bottlenecks and dispatch handoff lags produced customer SLA penalties in wholesale delivery.
projects.solution: Mapped end-to-end driver, warehouse, and dispatch workflows. Designed an automated scheduling and digital manifest handoff system.
projects.impact: Projected a 20% reduction in delivery transit delays.
